title: Plumbing — Template 3 (ClearFlow)
notes: ClearFlow: calm Scandinavian-editorial plumbing site in forest teal, warm sand and sage, with arched photo frames and organic water shapes. 41 static pages incl. /projects/[slug]. Postal-code checker against configured coverage, project filters, animated service timeline, quote form with home/business and urgency conditional fields. One-screen hero. Every business detail is a placeholder in src/config/business.ts; credentials, emergency cover, reviews and company story stay hidden until supplied. Form needs NEXT_PUBLIC_QUOTE_ENDPOINT (worker included). Photos are free-licence Unsplash stock.
